turns.text: The dry bootstrap is open. We need four crop-top concepts and no launch theatre.
One Good Day gives the joke a repeatable frame. Each concept needs its own typographic device.
The audience floor is 18. Use public interests only; no personal data or invented audience size.
The arc can sequence four concept chapters. No price, stock, release or paid-channel claim belongs in it.
Use product and type only. Unverified hashtag claims stay marked VERIFY and block publish-ready status.
Approve the planning record. It authorizes no production, publishing, spend, account or commerce action.
Record 4 concepts under One Good Day. Owner ratings decide what graduates.
